triage.notes: Decision needed: Is surfacing decks that lack an archetype's highest-playability card useful to admins (finding mis-categorized decks) or just noise (single-card variants)? The data query is straightforward using _season_archetype_playability but the UI/UX and threshold are the owner's call.
